title: scheduler: answer its provider notices
prior_work: Answer this module's provider notices, judged affected by a read-only triage: question-explorer:90 (index.mjs:481 calls exploreTick, whose account read changed). For each, decide from your own requirements what this module must do (the T53 ops that replace the retired ones are in ai-accounts' requirements and op-declarations), adapt or confirm, and add a test of your own for the change, failing with it reverted where code changes; where your requirements decide nothing, name the gap in not-verified. status.reason: R12's plane test (plane.test.mjs::R12) fails before any scheduler code runs: op=aiownadd at line 238 answers CATALOGUE_UNAVAILABLE, because no running (Miniflare) plane holds an AI catalogue with plans. The Store class hands assembleStore no catalogueKeys (store-assembly R1), nothing in src/ calls ai-catalogue's receive or loadSeed, and the release seed RELEASE_SEED holds plans: []. I tried giving the plane a development deployment's variables from ai-catalogue's own makeDevelopmentKey (AI_CATALOGUE_DEVELOPMENT=1, the key line, the seed signature): the seed loads, but aiownadd then answers UNKNOWN_PLAN for plan 'api', since the seed lists no plan. I reverted that try; this branch has no code change. Same cause, other module: capture-requests' plane.test.mjs fails all 7 tests (0 passed). Owner: store-assembly, which composes the plane's catalogue, with ai-catalogue, whose seed or channel would have to carry plans: a test or development plane needs a way to hold a signed catalogue with plans (for example a development-signed payload handed by env, or a test plane's seed through the assembled catalogue's loadSeed). R12 itself is met in-process by scheduler's notice-ai-runs-323.test.mjs, which passes. Restart this job once a running plane can connect an account.
